The '''Scraplands''' of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] were a vast waste north of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]].

==Description==
Essentially a dumping ground for the original colonists of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the area of barren expanse known as the Scraplands was the result of thousands of years of manufactured waste. Strip mining operations, shipyards, and salvage pits, littered the landscape, while destroyed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other [[Starship/Legends|starship]] remains were left there to be recycled or broken down in [[Acid/Legends|acid]] lakes that dotted the location. An environment unique to Ord Mantell, the Scraplands were the most expansive and inhospitable dumping grounds in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Constantly choked by smog blowing in from Worlport and the smoke of thousands of fires burning eternally amidst the trash, visitors and workers in the area required breath masks to survive in the region.<ref name="MPQ" />

While no native life thrived in the Scraplands, some beings tried to irk out a living among the unstable piles of waste. [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrips]] hunted in the region, making it dangerous for unarmed individuals to wander far out of their settlements. Nomads and the impoverished dug through the trash looking for valuable tools and parts that could be sold. Settlements, known as squats, popped up in the region; though high mortality forced these settlements to break up and disperse. One of these squats, called [[Yalawua]], was home to many [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="MPQ" />

The Scrapyard's main form of transportation was an [[armored hovertrain]] rail system established by Mantellians to service the larger communities there. While the trains fell into disrepair by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], two lines were still maintained and were used to transport cargo and individuals between Worlport and other civilized areas.<ref name="MPQ" />

Ord Mantell used its huge scrape yards to supply the cities with energy by making fossil fuels. Scrapeyards were common on Ord Mantell and took up a large part of the planet's landscape.<ref name="SWG:KBS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Journal Entry: "Kallor Brothers: Sulale"</ref> [[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droids]] were often found in the junkyards. Scavengers who came there to find something to sell on the black market often disappeared in the scrapyards.<ref name="SWG:ItC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Journal Entry: "In the Crossfire"</ref>

==History==
The assassin droid [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]] interrogated and [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Dash Rendar)|battled]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] at a salvage plant during the Civil War.<ref name="SotE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref>
